entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault. The thing is basically garbage. The readings are completely inaccurate.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. We can definitely try some troubleshooting steps to see if we can resolve the issue for you.
Look, I really don't have time for that. I just want a refund. Can you do that or not?
I understand. Let me just check the policy for you. I see here that your item was delivered 26 days ago. One moment while I review the return eligibility.
Okay, I've pulled it up. Our policy states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can go ahead and process this return for you.
So you'll actually give me a refund for this piece of garbage?
Yes, absolutely. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Just pack the item in its original box and attach the label. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed.
Whatever. I just want money back on my card, not some store credit.
Not a problem. It will be a full refund to your original payment method. The email with the label has been sent. Can I help with anything else?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
